limitations: Descriptive end-to-end configuration measurements; no profiled bottleneck, controlled provider load or statistical performance superiority.
Three repetitions per problem, twelve distinct synthetic problems; repetitions are not independent capability cases.
Novelty against training data and public benchmark similarity were not audited.
Private checks cover some validation/authorization/regression behavior, not a complete security audit or future production defects.
Strict acceptance mixes patch criteria and native/provider/observation completion. Correct patches can still be rejected operationally.
